record.name: Meta Ads
record.one_liner: Create, manage and optimize ad campaigns across Meta technologies including Facebook and Instagram.
record.access_note: Developers sign up at Meta for Developers, create a developer app, and add the Marketing API product at no cost.
record.api_note: Covers ads, ad sets, campaigns, creatives, custom audiences, insights, and catalogs via the Graph and Marketing APIs.
record.blocker_note: Production apps require app review to unlock standard tier rate limits and permissions.
